row.title: Head of Marketing, Langfuse
row.description_text:
About Langfuse

Langfuse is the open-source LLM engineering platform that helps teams build useful AI applications through tracing, evaluation, prompt management, datasets, and metrics. We are now part of Canary Employer 01. Like Canary Employer 01, Langfuse is open source, and we work in public: our product, docs, changelog, roadmap, and community discussions are visible to the developers and teams who use us. Langfuse is already one of the most widely adopted platforms in the category: trusted by 19 of the Fortune 50 and 63 of the Fortune 500, with 50M+ SDK installs per month, 6M+ Docker pulls, and 30k+ GitHub stars.

We are hiring a Head of Marketing for Langfuse.

This is a hands-on marketing leadership role for someone with deep experience in product marketing, developer marketing, and technical content. You will own how Langfuse shows up in the market, manage the Langfuse marketing team, and turn our current founder-led, product-led motion into a holistic marketing ecosystem.

The core of the role is still product marketing and developer trust: positioning, launches, category narrative, developer content, website, customer proof, lifecycle, funnel, sales enablement, and the way we explain Langfuse to technical users and technical buyers. At the same time, Langfuse now has access to Canary Employer 01's global go-to-market engine. You will be the person who makes those resources work for Langfuse without diluting the Langfuse voice.

What You'll Do

Own Langfuse marketing strategy and execution globally, with product marketing and developer content as the center of gravity.
Manage and develop the Langfuse marketing team, including Product Marketing Engineering, Developer Advocacy, and Product Marketing content and resources.
Define the operating model for Langfuse marketing: what sits in the Langfuse pod, what runs through Canary Employer 01 shared teams, who owns what, and how we measure whether it is working.
Build the marketing plan across positioning, launches, website narrative including product pages and conversion paths, customer proof, onboarding, lifecycle, funnel, sales collateral, campaigns, and events.
Own the Langfuse category narrative: LLM observability, evals, prompt management, datasets, agent observability, self-hosting, and the broader LLM engineering workflow.
Keep the developer motion strong: useful technical content, examples, cookbooks, docs-adjacent education, changelog, town halls, open-source communication, and high-trust product launches.
Partner with Canary Employer 01 demand generation and field marketing to make enterprise marketing systematic rather than ad hoc: webinars, workshops, regional events, conferences, paid campaigns, retargeting, and follow-up motions.
Create the canonical Langfuse sales narrative and enablement system so Canary Employer 01 AEs, SAs, field teams, and leadership can confidently explain Langfuse.
Lead customer marketing and proof: case studies, technical stories, customer references, logo strategy, community stories, enterprise migration stories, and reusable sales narratives.
Use data to run the function: unique visitors, signups, activation, revenue, product usage signals, campaign performance, attribution, event ROI, pipeline creation, pipeline acceleration, and qualitative user feedback.

What You Bring Along

You have led product marketing, developer marketing, DevRel, growth, or demand gen marketing for a technical SaaS product.
You have marketed to developers, infrastructure teams, AI teams, data teams, security teams, observability teams, or another highly technical audience.
You are a strong product marketer at the core: positioning, narrative, launch strategy, competitive thinking, customer proof, sales enablement, and technical buyer messaging are natural territory for you.
You write exceptionally well. You can make complex technical ideas clear without making them shallow.
You are technical enough to use the product, understand the market, earn credibility with engineers, and spot vague or misleading marketing.
You understand product-led growth and open-source funnels: activation, onboarding, conversion, lifecycle, self-serve adoption, usage signals, and sales-assisted expansion.
You understand enterprise marketing enough to work with demand gen, field marketing, sales, solutions, and regional teams. You do not need to personally run every event or paid campaign, but you need to know what good looks like and how to make the system work.
You can manage a small, high-talent team while remaining hands-on where the work needs senior judgment.
You are comfortable building the function while the company is changing around you. Some work will be cleanly owned. Some work will require influence, coordination, and judgment across a larger organization.
You already create content: blog posts, talks, product explainers, social posts, newsletters, videos, docs, demos, or open-source examples.

Perks

Flexible work environment - Canary Employer 01 is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries.
Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare.
Equity in the company - Every new team member who joins our company receives stock options.
Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries.
A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee.
Global Gatherings – We believe in the power of in-person connection and offer opportunities to engage with colleagues at company-wide offsites.

Culture - We All Shape It

As part of a rapidly scaling start-up, you will be instrumental in shaping our culture.

Are you interested in finding out more about our culture? Learn more about our values here. Check out our blog posts or follow us on LinkedIn to find out more about what’s happening at Canary Employer 01.

Equal Opportunity & Privacy

Canary Employer 01 provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type based on factors such as race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

Please see here for our Privacy Statement.

Compensation Range: $190K - $270K

row.title: Global Vice President, CPQ Sales
row.description_text:
Founded in 2021, Canary Employer 02 empowers manufacturing businesses to better design, model, develop, and sell—powering greater outcomes across the entire manufacturing value chain. Canary Employer 02 leads with an AI-forward mindset—using technology as a catalyst, not a compass. We value initiative and adaptability and seek professionals who embrace AI-driven innovation to drive business results in a rapidly evolving market. 

We’re shaping the future of manufacturing technology with industry-leading CPQ, PLM, and design solutions that transform data into opportunity and accelerate the journey from idea to cash. 

Canary Employer 02 serves more than 16,000 global customers and is a portfolio company of TA Associates and Hg. 



Job Description

The CPQ Sales Leader is the executive owner of Canary Employer 02's CPQ solution line accountable for driving bookings growth across the flagship products, ConfigureOne and AutoQuotes, and historical CPQ brands on opportunistic basis globally.



The Sales Leader sets the long-term sales vision and go-to-market architecture for CPQ, partnering at the C-suite level to align product, marketing, and customer success around a unified growth strategy. The Sales Leader thrives in high paced, PE backed company environment: building operating rigor while staying close to the market and the customer.



Success is defined by consistent bookings attainment, pipeline health, team development, and the ability to expand Canary Employer 02's CPQ market share and brand among key industry influencers. 

Key Responsibilities

Own the CPQ sales number — set annual and quarterly bookings targets and drive the team to consistent attainment across new logo, upsell, and cross-sell motions. 
Lead and develop a team of people leaders and individual contributors building a high-performance culture grounded in accountability, coaching, and continuous development. 
Design and execute the global CPQ go-to-market strategy, including territory design, segmentation, coverage model, sales playbooks, and compensation structure. 
Partner with the Chief Sales Officer and executive team to contribute to corporate strategy, board reporting, and PE investor communications on CPQ segment performance. 
Establish and grow executive-level relationships with key enterprise accounts and strategic channel partners, serving as an executive sponsor on marquee deals. 
Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Marketing, Professional Services, and Customer Success to align GTM strategy, refine messaging and packaging, and deliver cohesive customer experiences. 
Champion the adoption of AI-powered sales tools, CRM discipline, and data-driven decision-making to optimize pipeline management, forecasting accuracy, and rep productivity. 
Monitor competitive dynamics, market trends, and emerging buyer needs across the manufacturing technology sector to sharpen positioning and identify growth opportunities. 
Deliver accurate pipeline reporting, forecasting, and business reviews to the CSO and executive leadership, ensuring full visibility into CPQ segment health. 
Represent Canary Employer 02 externally at industry events, customer advisory boards, and analyst briefings to build brand presence and thought leadership in the CPQ market. 

Qualifications

Requirements / Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Business, Sales, Marketing, or a related field; MBA strongly preferred. 
15+ years of progressive enterprise software sales experience, with at least 7 years in a VP or SVP sales leadership role managing multi-region teams. 
Demonstrated track record of owning and exceeding $15M+ annual revenue targets in a complex, solution-based sales environment. 
Experience leading sales organizations through sales transformations based on product evolution. 
Proven ability to recruit, develop, and retain top sales talent — including directors and individual contributors — across geographies. 
Strong financial and business acumen, with experience contributing to P&L ownership, annual planning, and executive-level reporting. 
Executive presence and credibility to engage C-level customers, PE sponsors, and board members; ability to influence and build alignment at all levels. 
Deep knowledge of enterprise sales methodologies (MEDDIC/MEDDPICC, Challenger, or equivalent) and modern sales operating practices. 
Experience driving adoption of AI-powered sales tools and CRM platforms (Salesforce) to improve forecasting, pipeline management, and rep effectiveness. 
Ability to operate across EMEA and North America, with comfort managing remote and distributed teams across time zones and cultures. 
Preferences / Nice-to-Haves

Direct CPQ product experience — selling, implementing, or leading teams that sell Configure-Price-Quote solutions. 
Deep domain knowledge in manufacturing technology, industrial software, or engineer-to-order (ETO) environments. 
Experience in a PE-backed, multi-brand vertical SaaS company with an acquisition-led growth strategy. 
Familiarity with adjacent enterprise software markets: PLM, ERP, or engineering design tools (CAD/CAM). 
Active network and thought leadership presence in the manufacturing technology or CPQ ecosystem. 
Track record of building and scaling partner and channel programs to extend geographic or vertical reach. 




Additional Information

Canary Employer 02 designates standard working hours as 8:00 am to 5:00 pm Eastern Time (ET) for employees based in the United States and 08:00 to 17:00 Central European Time (CET) for employees operating within the EMEA region.


Qualified applicants will be asked to complete a 30 minute online pre-employment assessment as part of the recruitment process. 


Canary Employer 02 is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. Canary Employer 02 participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law.

The compensation offered to the successful candidate will be based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to, the candidate’s work experience, education and licenses, work-related training, key skills, the core duties of the role and its associated responsibilities, additional benefits offered, and the location where the work will be performed. row.title: Sales Development Representative Lead
row.description_text:
About Canary Employer 04

Canary Employer 04 is the AI Site Reliability Engineer (AI SRE) for the enterprise.

Production complexity was already outpacing what engineering teams could manage manually, and AI-generated code is accelerating that gap. Canary Employer 04 is built for that challenge, autonomously understanding and reasoning across even the largest, most complex production environments to diagnose, fix, and prevent incidents. Our mission is to free engineers from endless firefighting and give them more time to focus on creative, high-impact work.

Today, Canary Employer 04 operates in mission-critical environments at some of the world’s largest enterprises. Our roots remain deeply embedded in AI research, and we’ve brought together researchers from institutions including MIT, Harvard, Berkeley, Columbia, and Cornell with world-class technical staff and operators from companies like Google, Meta, Datadog, ServiceNow, and Citadel Securities to take on one of the hardest problems for AI to solve. Canary Employer 04 is backed by Sequoia Capital, Kleiner Perkins, Hanabi, NFDG, and American Express Ventures.

The Role

As an SDR Lead, you will build and lead a high-performing outbound sales development team. You'll own the strategy, execution, and coaching that turns targeted account lists into qualified pipeline for our Account Executive team — while staying hands-on with the reps you manage.

You'll set the outbound playbook, manage a small pod of SDRs day to day, and work cross-functionally with Sales, Marketing, and RevOps to keep pipeline generation predictable and scalable.

Responsibilities

Hire, onboard, coach, and manage a team of SDRs, setting clear activity, quality, and pipeline-generation targets. 
Own the outbound playbook — messaging, sequencing, and prospecting motions — across email, phone, and social, refining it based on what converts. 
Partner with Marketing to align on inbound lead routing, qualification criteria (e.g., MQL/SQL definitions), and campaign follow-up. 
Work with RevOps to define and track SDR KPIs (activity volume, meetings booked, meeting-to-opportunity conversion, pipeline sourced) and keep Salesforce data clean and consistent. 
Segment and prioritize target account lists in partnership with Sales leadership, using tools like Clay and Apollo for enrichment and list-building. 
Own our investor-network outreach motion — coordinating warm-intro requests through Sequoia, KP, and other VC/angel partners, holding SDRs accountable to daily outreach targets against our top-tier accounts, and reporting outreach effectiveness back to those partners. 
Build and maintain a systematic, tiered outreach plan across our top target accounts, and stand up signal/trigger-based prospecting (job changes, outages, new exec hires) in partnership with RevOps and GTM tooling like Clay. 
Own the post-event follow-up motion (conferences, dinners, exec briefings) with a consistent SOP so event engagement reliably converts into booked meetings. 
Run weekly 1:1s, pipeline reviews, and call coaching sessions; use Gong to review calls and sharpen team messaging. 
Serve as an escalation point for complex or high-value accounts, and stay hands-on in prospecting when needed. 
Report on team performance and pipeline contribution to sales leadership, flagging risks and opportunities early. 
Champion AI-driven ways of working across the team — using tools like Claude to speed up account research, personalize outbound messaging at scale, and automate routine reporting, so reps spend more time selling and less time on manual busywork. 

Requirements

1–3+ years of experience managing or leading an SDR/BDR team, ideally at a B2B SaaS company selling into enterprise or technical buyers. 
A track record of building or scaling outbound pipeline generation — you can point to specific playbooks or programs you've built. 
Strong coaching instincts: you can listen to a call or read a sequence and immediately identify what to fix. 
Comfort with a modern GTM stack (Salesforce, Apollo, Clay, Gong, Outreach/Salesloft or similar); ability to get hands-on with tooling rather than just directing others. 
Data-driven approach to managing a team — comfortable setting targets, tracking conversion rates, and adjusting tactics based on results. 
Excellent written and verbal communication; ability to represent the voice of the customer back to Marketing and Product. 
Experience selling into technical audiences (engineering, DevOps, SRE) or incident-management/observability space is a strong plus. 

Nice to Have

Experience at an early-stage or high-growth startup where the process is still being built, not just inherited. 
Familiarity with account-based prospecting into large enterprise accounts (Fortune 500 / strategic logos). 
Experience partnering directly with RevOps on comp design, territory planning, or lead scoring. 

Compensation

We offer competitive compensation, startup equity, health insurance, and additional benefits. The U.S. base salary range for this full-time, role is $200,000 - $275,000 OTE, plus equity and benefits. Our salary ranges are based on location, level, and role. Individual compensation is determined by experience, skills, and job-related knowledge.

Why You Should Join Us

Canary Employer 04 is a place to take on hard, meaningful problems with real ownership from day one. You’ll work alongside people who challenge you to grow, learn constantly, and help define a new category of infrastructure software. We think long term, move quickly, and hold a high bar without taking ourselves too seriously.

We offer competitive salary and equity packages, health insurance, fertility benefits, a great tech setup stipend and flexible time off. Plus in-office snacks, team happy hours and outings, an annual company offsite, and plenty of built in time to collaborate across teams.

Come join us! Let’s shape the future of hospitality together.

Position Summary
Canary Employer 16 is seeking a Robotic Welding & Automation Specialist to take ownership of our robotic welding operations and help expand automation throughout our manufacturing facility.

We are looking for someone who will actively identify opportunities for automation, pull appropriate work from our production schedule, program and implement jobs, develop fixtures and processes, troubleshoot equipment, and keep our robotic welding systems producing.

Our current robotic welding equipment includes an OTC/Daihen industrial welding robot and a Miller collaborative welding system (cobot). We intend to continue investing in robotic welding and automation as utilization and opportunities grow.

The successful candidate will become Ameritex’s internal champion for robotic welding and automation and will be responsible for demonstrating where these technologies can improve throughput, consistency, quality, and labor utilization.

Key Responsibilities
Robotic Welding Operations
Own the day-to-day operation and utilization of Ameritex’s robotic welding equipment.
Program, set up, operate, and troubleshoot OTC/Daihen robotic welding systems and Miller welding cobots.
Develop and optimize weld programs, sequencing, travel speeds, torch angles, wire-feed settings, and welding parameters.
Perform changeovers and bring new parts and assemblies onto robotic welding systems.
Troubleshoot welding defects, programming issues, equipment faults, sensors, torch systems, wire-feed systems, and related automation.
Maintain robots, welding equipment, tooling, and work areas to a high standard of reliability and cleanliness.
Coordinate preventative maintenance and outside technical support when required.
Help ensure robotic welding equipment is available, reliable, and production-ready.

Find Work for the Robots
A major responsibility of this position is proactively identifying opportunities for automation.
Regularly review the production schedule, backlog, drawings, and upcoming jobs to identify components and assemblies suitable for robotic welding.
Work directly with scheduling, production supervisors, engineering, and welding departments to move appropriate work onto the robots.
Identify repetitive weldments, high-volume parts, product families, long-running jobs, and other automation opportunities.
Maintain a pipeline of upcoming robotic welding work so machines do not sit idle simply because work has not been assigned to them.
Evaluate whether existing manual welding processes can be redesigned or standardized to make them suitable for automation.
Look beyond the current schedule for recurring products that should become permanent robotic welding candidates.
The expectation is that this person pulls work toward the robots rather than waiting for work to be pushed to them.

New Part and Process Implementation
Review fabrication drawings, weld symbols, models, and production requirements to determine robotic welding feasibility.
Develop welding strategies for new components and assemblies.
Work with engineering and production teams to improve part design, tolerances, fit-up, and repeatability for robotic welding.
Develop or coordinate the development of fixtures, positioners, locating systems, and tooling needed to automate parts.
Conduct trials and prove out new robotic welding processes before releasing them to production.
Establish repeatable setups that reduce changeover time and operator dependency.
Document successful programs, setups, fixtures, weld parameters, and procedures so work can be repeated consistently.
Build families of programs and standardized processes that allow similar parts to be introduced quickly.

Automation Expansion
Ameritex intends for this position to help drive future investment in welding automation.
Track robot utilization, productive welding hours, throughput, labor savings, quality, and opportunities for additional automation.
Identify capacity constraints that could be addressed through additional robots, cobots, positioners, fixtures, or welding automation.
Help evaluate new robotic welding equipment and automation technologies.
Participate in equipment demonstrations and vendor discussions when additional automation is being considered.
Develop practical recommendations for where Ameritex should deploy its next robotic welding system.
Help create repeatable automation processes that can be scaled across the company.
Identify situations where automation can reduce bottlenecks, improve staffing efficiency, or increase production capacity.
Support management with data and recommendations that help justify future automation investments.

What Success Looks Like
This role will ultimately be judged by whether Ameritex’s welding robots become increasingly productive manufacturing assets.

Success includes:
Robots consistently have productive work scheduled.
Robot utilization increases over time.
New parts and assemblies are regularly converted from manual welding to robotic welding.
Robotic processes run reliably with minimal unnecessary downtime.
Programs, tooling, and processes become standardized and repeatable.
Production throughput improves without sacrificing weld quality.
Engineering begins considering robotic welding earlier in the design and manufacturing process.
Automation opportunities are identified before they become capacity constraints.
Clear business cases are developed for additional robotic welding equipment.
Ameritex becomes increasingly capable of scaling output through automation instead of relying only on additional labor.

Qualifications
Preferred Experience
Hands-on experience programming and operating industrial welding robots.
Experience with OTC/Daihen robotic welding systems strongly preferred.
Experience with Miller welding cobots or collaborative welding systems preferred.
Strong MIG/GMAW welding knowledge.
Understanding of welding parameters, joint design, fit-up, distortion, penetration, weld quality, and troubleshooting.
Experience developing robotic welding fixtures and tooling.
Ability to read fabrication drawings, weld symbols, and manufacturing documentation.
Experience troubleshooting robotic equipment, welding power sources, wire feeders, torches, sensors, and automation components.
Familiarity with positioners, safety systems, sensors, and basic robotic cell integration.
Experience with offline robot programming, CAD, or 3D models is a plus.
Experience in a production fabrication environment is strongly preferred.

Skills and Attributes
The ideal candidate is a combination of a welder, robot programmer, manufacturing problem-solver, and automation champion.

We are particularly interested in someone who:
Enjoys figuring out how to automate work.
Walks the floor looking for opportunities instead of waiting for assignments.
Understands production and cares about throughput.
Can work independently and take ownership of equipment and results.
Is comfortable working directly with welders, supervisors, engineers, schedulers, and management.
Can take a new part from drawing review through programming, fixturing, prove-out, and production.
Understands that a robot sitting idle is an opportunity to find its next job.
Can balance technical perfection with practical production needs.
Is organized enough to maintain programs, documentation, tooling, and repeatable setups.
Wants to build an automation program rather than simply operate one machine.
Is comfortable being accountable for utilization and implementation, not just maintenance.

Why This Role Matters
Ameritex is continuing to grow its manufacturing capacity and intends to make robotic welding and automation a larger part of its production strategy.

The person in this position will have significant influence over how robotic welding is deployed within the company. As utilization grows and additional opportunities are identified, Ameritex intends to continue investing in robots, cobots, tooling, positioners, and other automation technologies.

This is an opportunity for someone who wants to own and build a robotic welding and automation program, not simply operate a robot.

Responsibilities

Execute manual regression and smoke passes across software releases — on the product UI and on real robots — to catch regressions before they reach customers. 
Run broad exploratory testing across complex robotic workflows: probe edge cases, unusual sequences, and the failure modes scripted tests miss. 
Write and maintain clear, repeatable manual test cases in our test-management tool (Qase), and keep them current as features ship. 
File high-quality bug reports with precise reproduction steps, system state, logs, and firmware/build versions, so engineers can act without back-and-forth. 
Partner with SDETs and Systems Test Engineers to reproduce and isolate defects, and surface the coverage gaps you find along the way. 
Support release QA, including gated test runs and release-candidate validation, and report results clearly. 
Perform basic recovery on test hardware (re-home, reset) to keep test cells available.

Hardware Curiosity: Comfortable testing a product where software controls physical hardware, and aware that software bugs have physical consequences.

Methodical & Reliable: You follow procedures precisely, notice when something is off, and chase it down. 

Who You Are

row.title: Senior Manager, Revenue Intelligence & Analytics
row.description_text:
Canary Employer 28 is a fast-growing company and a leading supplier of IoT solutions, operating out of many offices worldwide. Canary Employer 28 specializes in digital solutions that connect machines, people, and systems in the global construction industry. The construction industry is the least digitalized industry of all — and we're changing that.

We are looking for a sharp, analytically rigorous, and strategically minded leader to own data, reporting, and decision support across our entire GTM organization. This is a builder role with real whitespace, real influence, and a mandate to shape how the GTM organization sees itself, plans its work, and makes decisions.

Right now, GTM data and visibility are fragmented across systems, teams, and tools. Decisions are delayed, leaders can't get what they need fast enough, and RevOps is too dependent on other teams for information it should own. You change that.

This is not a reporting role. It is a deeply analytical, strategic leadership role — and the scope is a leadership scope from day one. If you're excited by the opportunity to build something from the ground up, with the resources and executive visibility to make it stick, this is your role.

This role sits within GTM Operations, reporting to the Senior Director, GTM Operations, and is open for remote / hybrid candidates. It is a full-time position. No relocation assistance is offered.

What's in it for you?

A seat at the table. This capability is a priority from the CEO and executive team down. You will have direct visibility and genuine influence on how the GTM organization plans, compensates, and measures its revenue motion.
A well-resourced mandate. You will have a Data Analyst reporting to you, a dedicated GTM Data Scientist, and access to a GTM Engineer. This is not a solo analytics job.
Modern tooling — and the freedom to shape it. Databricks as the analytical backbone. Claude as the delivery layer, with reporting built as live, interactive artifacts across all GTM systems — not static decks and refreshed spreadsheets.
Room to grow. The title, scope, and team are designed to expand as the function matures around you.
A place in an agile growth SaaS business, with genuine opportunities to grow internally. We move quickly — back in 2020 we were 150 employees, and we've just passed 450.
International environment with regular check-ins and social events across teams, departments, and borders.
Personal and professional development taken seriously — through training, coaching, and an open feedback culture that helps you understand your impact on yourself, your team, and the organization.
Flexibility and hybrid working that isn't just a line in a job ad. Tell us how you work best, and we'll make it work.
Turning the Tide. At Canary Employer 28, we aim to create and contribute to an inclusive workplace. This priority starts with our hiring — we do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity, sexual orientation, personal expression, ethnicity, religious belief, or disability status. We assess candidates on their qualifications and merit only.

What You'll Own

You are the data and analytical authority for the GTM organization. That means:

GTM Data Ownership & Governance

Serve as the single source of truth for all GTM-related data: revenue, forecasting, deal visibility, comp and quota attainment, and territory/segment planning
Govern data across multiple, disjointed systems — bring it together, rationalize it, and ensure integrity across all downstream outputs
Define what each GTM metric means, how it is calculated, and which system it comes from — so that two people asking the same question get the same answer
Partner with the Data Scientist and Data Analyst to build reliable, well-structured data tables and source-of-truth views in Databricks

Analysis, Insight & Decision Support

Go well beyond describing what is visible. Interrogate the data, test hypotheses, and segment it until you understand the mechanics of the business
Translate analysis into a clear point of view and a specific recommendation — own the "so what" and the "now what" behind every number
Build the analytical narratives that set up decisions: scenario models, sensitivity analysis, and trade-off framing that give leadership a real basis for choosing between options
Proactively identify blind spots and emerging questions in the data before stakeholders think to ask

Forecasting & Revenue Planning

Own the forecast cycle end-to-end — what goes in, how it is used, where the gaps are, and what needs to change
Maintain a rolling view of pipeline health, attainment trajectory, and revenue risk across all segments, regions, and pods

Stakeholder Visibility & Self-Serve Analytics

Ensure every level of the GTM organization has visibility into what they need, at their fingertips:
Executives: full-company performance view with regional and pod-level drill-down
GTM leaders: team performance dashboard — quota, gap to quota, rep-level drill-down, comp clarity
Individual contributors: personal pipeline view, attainment status, and close requirements
Design for transparency: the organization should not be waiting on a weekly report to understand how it is performing
Compensation & Territory Planning

Partner with Global GTM Leadership and Finance on compensation target design and modeling for all revenue roles
Support the analytical work required to evaluate and model the transition from a Billed to a Booked compensation framework

Data Quality & Process Advisory

Act as the diagnostic engine for GTM data quality — trace issues back to the process, system, or behaviour that caused them, and advise GTM Operations on how to fix them at source
Build the feedback loop so this is continuous, not a one-off clean-up

Who You Are Ideally

7+ years in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or a GTM analytics function in a high-growth B2B SaaS environment
Genuinely strong analyst first — fast and rigorous with data, able to structure a question and get to a defensible answer without waiting for someone to build a report for you
Demonstrated expertise in revenue forecasting, pipeline management, and quota/comp analytics
Advanced proficiency in data manipulation and analysis. Excel is a foundation, not the destination — this role builds well beyond it
Working fluency in SQL and comfort in a modern data platform like Databricks: enough to query, validate, and reason about the data yourself
Curiosity and appetite for AI-native tooling. We build our reporting outputs as live, interactive artifacts in Claude — prior experience is welcome, but the real requirement is that you're excited to work this way and quick to learn
Familiarity with Salesforce and Clari, alongside other common GTM tools
Proven ability to build reporting and analytical infrastructure from the ground up in ambiguous, fast-moving environments
Experience leading or mentoring analysts and getting more out of specialist resources than their headcount would suggest
Opinionated strategic thinker — you form views, make recommendations, and tell the organization what the data means and what it should do about it
Comfortable in whitespace — energized by the lack of a fully defined playbook, not paralyzed by it

Don't meet every single requirement? No worries — if you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification, we encourage you to apply.

Our hiring process

Don't waste your time writing the best possible cover letter. We want you to create an impact that matters — and that's not in a cover letter.

Initial conversation with a colleague from our People & Talent team to get to know each other.
Virtual meet and greet with the Senior Director, GTM Operations.
Assignment-specific interview. You'll receive a case to prepare and present to relevant colleagues — giving you a real window into the work.
Offer presentation and walk-through. We're lucky to have you.

Canary Employer 29 is redefining construction by empowering the people who build our world. As Canary Employer 29 scales rentals and sales of our X1 retrofit kits and machines across North America, we’re looking for a Sales Operations Specialist to be the operational engine behind our growing US sales motion. This role owns the back-end execution of the sales and rental lifecycle-from order intake and contract setup through ERP execution and AR coordination. Serving as the critical liaison between Sales, Accounting, and our customers’ AP teams.

What You’ll Do 
How you’ll make impact:

This is a high-impact, build-from-the-ground-up role for someone who loves bringing structure to fast-moving operations and turning a growing book of complex sales and rentals into a clean, scalable system.

Core Responsibilities:
Lifecycle Management: Own the end-to-end sales and rental order lifecycle, from intake and contract setup (MSAs, SOWs) to close-out.
Contract Portfolio: Manage a high-volume, complex book of concurrent rental contracts with staggered milestones and billing schedules.
ERP Administration: Act as the Oracle ERP process owner, configuring and optimizing workflows tailored to the sales team's operations.
Cross-Functional Alignment: Serve as the primary liaison connecting Sales, Accounting, and customer AP teams to reconcile invoices and ensure clean revenue recognition.
Inside Sales Support: Partner with Account Executives to qualify leads, draft quotes, and drive the tactical sales cycle.
Data & Reporting: Maintain CRM hygiene and build unified reporting across pipeline, ERP, and AR data to establish a single source of truth.
Process Improvement: Identify friction points across the order-to-cash workflow and deploy scalable operational fixes.
Forecasting & Health Tracking: Partner with Finance to project rental revenue, track equipment utilization, and monitor overall contract health.

What You’ll Bring 
Minimum Qualifications: 
3–5 years of experience in sales operations, order management, or contracts administration.
Hands-on ERP experience (Oracle preferred) with a strong grasp of order-to-cash, invoicing, and revenue recognition processes.
Exceptional attention to detail, capable of managing multiple complex contracts, deadlines, and billing milestones concurrently without errors.
Strong written and verbal communication skills for direct collaboration with cross-functional stakeholders and external customers.
Founder’s mentality: Proactive, adaptable, and comfortable building processes in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

Direct experience administering Oracle ERP (Fusion, NetSuite, or EBS) alongside CRM/CLM platforms (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot).
Background supporting equipment rental, capital-equipment sales, construction tech, or industrial robotics businesses.
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Operations, Supply Chain, or a related field.

Why You’ll Love It Here
Join a fast-growing company helping modernize one of the world’s largest industries through construction automation and intelligent equipment technology.
Be part of a growing U.S. operation where your work will directly support the development, coordination, and scaling of field operations and internal processes.
Work alongside cross-functional teams across operations, field support, product, and leadership in a highly collaborative environment.
Competitive salary, performance incentives, retirement plan, and flexible work environment.

Job Description

Canary Employer 32 is seeking a dedicated and skilled Help Desk System Administrator to support the National Security Space Institute (NSSI) by ensuring the reliable operation, maintenance, and support of organizational information technology systems. This position serves as the primary point of contact for end-user technical assistance while providing systems administration support for desktop computers, servers, network infrastructure, audiovisual systems, and enterprise applications. The Help Desk System Administrator will troubleshoot and resolve technical issues, manage user accounts and system configurations, support cybersecurity best practices, and assist with IT projects that enable NSSI's education and training mission. The ideal candidate possesses strong technical troubleshooting skills, exceptional customer service abilities, and a solid foundation in systems administration, network support, and information security within a dynamic training environment.

Job Responsibilities For This Position Include

Technical Support and Customer Service

Provide Tier I and Tier II technical support for hardware, software, operating systems, network connectivity, printers, mobile devices, and collaboration tools.
Diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve technical issues submitted through service desk tickets, phone calls, email, or in-person requests.
Escalate complex technical issues to senior administrators, engineers, or external vendors as appropriate.
Maintain a high level of customer service and ensure timely resolution of user requests.

Systems Administration

Administer and maintain Windows workstations, servers, Active Directory, Group Policy, file shares, and enterprise applications.
Create, modify, disable, and manage user accounts, permissions, and access controls.
Configure and maintain system settings, security baselines, and organizational standards.
Monitor system performance, availability, and operational health.

Network and Infrastructure Support

Assist with the administration of network infrastructure, including switches, wireless access points, DNS, DHCP, and TCP/IP services.
Troubleshoot network connectivity issues and support local and remote users.
Support audiovisual equipment, conference room technology, and classroom systems as required.

Security and Compliance

Implement and maintain cybersecurity best practices in accordance with organizational policies and regulatory requirements.
Apply security patches, operating system updates, and firmware upgrades.
Assist with vulnerability remediation, system hardening, and compliance activities.
Maintain proper access controls and ensure protection of organizational data and information systems.

Asset and Configuration Management

Maintain accurate inventory records of hardware, software licenses, and IT assets.
Track equipment lifecycle activities including procurement, deployment, maintenance, replacement, and disposition.
Assist with hardware and software acquisition recommendations and implementation.

Documentation and Knowledge Management

Maintain technical documentation, standard operating procedures, system diagrams, and configuration records.
Document incidents, service requests, troubleshooting steps, and resolutions within the ticketing system.
Develop and update knowledge base articles to improve user self-service capabilities.

Backup and Disaster Recovery

Verify successful completion of scheduled backups and assist with recovery operations.
Support disaster recovery and continuity of operations activities.
Participate in testing and validation of recovery procedures.

Project and Team Support

Assist with IT projects, system deployments, migrations, upgrades, and technology refresh initiatives.
Participate in testing and validation of new technologies and software solutions.
Coordinate with network engineers, cybersecurity personnel, developers, and vendors to implement solutions and resolve issues.

Required Experience

Experience and Skills

Experience providing help desk support, systems administration, and end-user technical assistance in an enterprise IT environment.
Proficiency supporting Microsoft Windows desktop and server operating systems, Active Directory, Microsoft 365, and enterprise collaboration tools.
Knowledge of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, switching, wireless networking, and connectivity troubleshooting.
Ability to diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve hardware, software, system, and network issues efficiently and effectively.
Strong customer service, communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities.
Experience working in DoD, federal government, or contractor-operated IT environments is preferred.
Familiarity with virtualization platforms, cloud technologies, cybersecurity best practices, vulnerability management, backup and recovery solutions, and audiovisual/classroom technologies.
Ability to install, configure, maintain, and support IT equipment and infrastructure in office, classroom, and server room environments.

Certifications

DoD 8140/8570 compliant (Relevant education, technical training, and industry certifications such as CompTIA A+, Network+, Security+, Microsoft certifications, or ITIL Foundation are desirable.)

Security Clearance

Active Secret clearance; TS/SCI eligible preferred.

Education

Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline preferred. 
Equivalent experience accepted in lieu of degree.

Physical Requirements

Ability to lift and carry network equipment (up to 50 lbs.) as needed.
Ability to work on-site at the National Security Space Institute, including secure areas such as SCIF environments.
Occasional after-hours support may be required during assessments, inspections, or incident response activities.
